# GeoIP test fixture

`GeoIP2-City-Test.mmdb` is the City test database of the MaxMind-DB project
(https://github.com/maxmind/MaxMind-DB, `test-data/GeoIP2-City-Test.mmdb`), published for testing under
CC BY-SA 3.0 / Apache-2.0 terms (see the repository's LICENSE files). It contains fictional/test data only, not real
GeoLite2 data. Known entries: `81.2.69.142` London GB, `89.160.20.112` Linkoping SE, `2.125.160.216` Boxford GB (English name only).
